description: Spike: with a real rk_test_ key, record whether GET /v1/account (accounts.retrieve) works without extra permissions, and the SDK error type/code/message for a missing permission

Spike: with a real rk_test_ key, record for each Stripe write we use whether a call against a nonexistent object id returns a permission error (denied) or resource-missing (permitted), without creating data
Permission manifest module declaring Stripe permission id, access level, covered operations and capability group (webhooks, core-payments, saved-cards-auto-pay, customer-import)
Manifest marks any permission that cannot be probed safely as checked on first use
Shared secret-key validator accepting sk_ and rk_ keys (live and test) and rejecting pk_ and other values
PaymentSettings form uses the shared validator and the updated error string
StripeConnectionSettings form uses the shared validator and the updated error string
connectStripeAction validates the secret-key format on the server before any Stripe call
Permission check runs each manifest read probe with limit 1 and each safe write probe against a nonexistent id, returning per-permission granted/denied/unchecked
Permission failures from Stripe are translated into an error naming the capability and the missing permission id
connectStripeAction runs the permission check before storing anything; missing webhooks or core-payments permission fails the connect and names the permissions
connectStripeAction succeeds with missing saved-cards-auto-pay or customer-import permissions and returns those capabilities as unavailable with the permission names
A webhook setup failure caused by a missing permission is reported as that missing permission, not as a generic webhook failure
sk_ keys pass the permission check and connect exactly as before
testStripeConnectionAction reports per-capability status from the same permission check
The other StripeAuthenticationError-only error mappings (test connection and the third site) also translate permission errors
Connected state of StripeConnectionSettings offers Update API keys, opening the key form
Update API keys calls the connect path and keeps the webhook endpoint id, the signing secret and all saved payment settings
Key input help lists the manifest permissions grouped by capability, collapsed by default, in both forms
Connect success with unavailable capabilities shows a warning listing capability and missing permission
Update secretKeyPlaceholder, invalidSecretKey and secretKeyFormat in the nine locale files (de, en, es, fr, it, nl, pl, pt, sv) and add the new strings
Drift test scans payment-actions, StripePaymentProvider and stripeWebhookEvents for stripe.<resource>.<method> calls and fails when one is not covered by the manifest
Docs permission table generated from or compared against the manifest by a test
Fix online-payments.md (nm-store): accept sk_ or rk_, remove the contradiction, add the permission table and how to create the restricted key
Add restricted-key setup and the in-place key swap steps to docs/stripe-integration-setup.md
